name: TAL_IV
comments: The volunteers received a constant-rate intravenous (IV) infusion of 30 mg racemic talinolol (=82.64 pmol talinolol, in a physiological NaCl solution) over 30min via a cannula inserted into a forearm vein.

name: TAL_PO
comments: The oral dose of 50 mg racemic talinolol (=137.74pmol talinolol) was administered as a dragee (Cordanum'@50in a new formulation) together with 150mL water (room temperature).
